title: Grayscale quietly drops Cardano, Polkadot and Hedera ETF plans
summary: The asset manager said it no longer intends to proceed with the offerings. None became effective, and no securities were issued or sold.

title: Solana lending giant Jupiter now lets the same dollar earn twice
summary: The new Lend v2 product turns deposits and borrowed assets into trading liquidity, tying higher returns to whether Jupiter’s router can send enough swap flow to the new vaults.

title: Bitmine’s ETH buying slows as Tom Lee's firm shifts capital to share buybacks
summary: Chairman Tom Lee said easing financial conditions could support crypto, even as the CLARITY Act failed to reach a Senate vote before the August recess.

title: Solana gets its first Strategy STRC product through Solstice Finance
summary: The Solana vault splits income from Strategy’s preferred stock into a lower-risk senior token and a higher-risk junior token.

title: Strategy sells 1,690 bitcoin, raises $653 million from MSTR shares
summary: The company increased its USD reserve to $4.65 billion while reducing its bitcoin holdings to 840,447 BTC
